report_card.goal: Create an experience-sdk scoped extension QA registry, Bun CLI, and driver skill without using the full CLI command facade.

friction.note: Driver first treated Fallow and skill-feedback as repo-local only; user clarified the skill bundles were available externally.

verification_burden.note: Checked CLI smoke, handoff JSON, registry validation, frontmatter parsing, formatting, diff whitespace, and Fallow introduced findings.

observations.summary: Fallow can run from the external skill bundle with --root pointed at experience-sdk.
Read-only MVP fit the accepted slice; add/edit/remove roles remains a write-gated follow-up.

evidence_gaps.message: Closeout could not read skill version.
Closeout has no trusted runtime model source.
Closeout did not include an explicit skill run id.
Skill-attributed cost is unavailable in v1.
